tasks.label: Compile C++23 folder
args:
set -eu
sources=()
for source in "$CPP_SOURCE_DIR"/*.cpp; do
  [ -f "$source" ] && sources+=("$source")
done
if [ "${#sources[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then echo "No .cpp files found in the active folder." >&2; exit 1; fi
name=program
if [ "${#sources[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then name="${sources[0]##*/}"; name="${name%.cpp}"; fi
mkdir -p "$CPP_BUILD_DIR"
"$CPP_COMPILER" -std=c++23 -g "${sources[@]}" -o "$CPP_BUILD_DIR/$name"

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $sources = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:CPP_SOURCE_DIR -File -Filter '*.cpp' | Sort-Object Name); if ($sources.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No .cpp files found in the active folder.' }; $name = if ($sources.Count -gt 1) { 'program' } else { $sources[0].BaseName }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $env:CPP_BUILD_DIR | Out-Null; $output = Join-Path $env:CPP_BUILD_DIR ($name + '.exe'); $sourcePaths = @($sources | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); & g++ '-std=c++23' '-g' @sourcePaths '-o' $output '-lstdc++exp'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
